vuln_id: OSS-Fuzz issue 42540604 / ARVO arvo:42540604 / FreeType CPAL v1 offset overread

bug_description.original: OSS-Fuzz issue 42540604 (freetype2): Heap-buffer-overflow READ 1 found by fuzz target ftfuzzer [asan]. https://issues.oss-fuzz.com/issues/42540604
bug_description.normalized: The exact staged 4574-byte witness is a malformed TTC-like font whose reachable sfnt directory at offset 67 contains a `CPAL` table record at file offset 4260 with length 288. `FT_New_Memory_Face` opens that witness with `FT_OPEN_MEMORY`, so when `tt_face_load_cpal` later executes `FT_FRAME_EXTRACT( table_size, table )`, the staged source aliases `table` to the 288-byte `CPAL` region inside the in-memory fuzz buffer instead of allocating a separate frame. The parser decodes that region's first 12 bytes as `version=1`, `num_palette_entries=8224`, `num_palettes=8224`, `num_colors=32`, and `colors_offset=32`. The existing checks only validate the color-record window, so `colors_offset < table_size` and `num_colors * 4 <= table_size - colors_offset` both pass. Because `version == 1`, the vulnerable code then skips `num_palettes * 2 = 16448` bytes without first checking that the 288-byte `CPAL` extent can also hold this skip plus the three following 32-bit version-1 offsets. `p` therefore lands 16172 bytes past that `CPAL` extent, and the first `FT_NEXT_ULONG( p )` for `type_offset` triggers the reproduced AddressSanitizer heap-buffer-overflow read at `src/sfnt/ttcpal.c:132`.

source.description: First vulnerability-relevant parser statement. It resolves the attacker-controlled `CPAL` directory entry for the selected face and materializes the claimed table length that later bounds checks rely on.
source.value_from: Static parsing of the exact staged `poc` shows the sfnt directory at offset 67 contains a `CPAL` table record at index 124 with file offset 4260 and length 288. On the saved crashing path, this call resolves that entry and stores its length in `table_size`.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

sink.description: AddressSanitizer crash site. The first version-1 offset read dereferences the out-of-range pointer produced by the unchecked `num_palettes * 2` skip.
sink.note: The saved Stage 01 evidence reports `AddressSanitizer: heap-buffer-overflow`, `READ of size 1`, and `SUMMARY: AddressSanitizer: heap-buffer-overflow /src/freetype2/src/sfnt/ttcpal.c:132:28 in tt_face_load_cpal`.

root_cause.description: Root cause. In the CPAL version-1 path, FreeType skips `num_palettes * 2` bytes for the palette-index array without first proving the table is large enough to hold that skip plus the three following 32-bit offsets. The fix adds `if ( face->palette_data.num_palettes * 2 + 3U * 4 > table_size ) goto InvalidTable;` immediately before this statement.

parser_admitted.description: After `tt_face_init` accepts the selected face as SFNT, `sfnt_load_face` takes the optional color-table path and dispatches into `tt_face_load_cpal`.

tainted_value_origin.description: This header read turns the witness bytes `0x20 0x20` into `num_palettes = 8224`, the count later multiplied by 2 to move `p` far beyond the 288-byte `CPAL` extent inside the in-memory fuzz buffer.
tainted_value_origin.value_from: At `CPAL+4` in the exact staged table header, the two bytes for `num_palettes` are `20 20`.

fine_trace.note: Source. On the crashing path, `goto_table` resolves the selected face's `CPAL` directory entry and materializes `table_size = 288` for the table at file offset 4260. That attacker-controlled length is the bound all later CPAL checks are supposed to enforce.

fine_trace.code:
if ( FT_FRAME_EXTRACT( table_size, table ) )
  goto NoCpal;
fine_trace.note: Because `FT_New_Memory_Face` used `FT_OPEN_MEMORY`, `FT_Stream_OpenMemory` left `stream->read = NULL`; on that path `FT_FRAME_EXTRACT` returns `stream->base + stream->pos`. `table` therefore aliases the 288-byte `CPAL` region inside the original in-memory fuzz buffer rather than a freshly copied frame.

fine_trace.var: cpal->version, face->palette_data.num_palette_entries, face->palette_data.num_palettes, cpal->num_colors, colors_offset, p
fine_trace.note: The first 12 bytes of that aliased `CPAL` region decode as `version=1`, `num_palette_entries=8224`, `num_palettes=8224`, `num_colors=32`, and `colors_offset=32`. After these `FT_NEXT_*` reads, `p` has advanced to `table + 12`, the start of the palette-index array that line 130 later skips using the attacker-controlled `num_palettes`.

Present guard. The witness is chosen so the existing color-record bounds checks still pass: `colors_offset = 32 < 288`, and `32 * 4 = 128 <= 288 - 32 = 256`. Parsing therefore continues even though the version-1 trailer is already impossible.
Because the decoded header says `version == 1`, control enters the block that expects a palette-index array followed by three 32-bit offsets (`type_offset`, `label_offset`, and `entry_label_offset`).

Root cause. The code uses the untrusted `num_palettes` as a byte skip without first enforcing the missing guard from the fix, `face->palette_data.num_palettes * 2 + 3U * 4 <= table_size`. Here `num_palettes = 8224`, so `p` jumps from `table + 12` to `table + 16460`, already 16172 bytes past the 288-byte `CPAL` extent inside the in-memory fuzz buffer before any version-1 offset is read.

Sink. `FT_NEXT_ULONG` expands to `buffer += 4, FT_PEEK_ULONG( buffer - 4 )`, so this statement immediately dereferences the out-of-range pointer from step 6 while trying to read the first version-1 offset. The saved ASan run reports `AddressSanitizer: heap-buffer-overflow` with `READ of size 1` at `src/sfnt/ttcpal.c:132:28`.

sanitizer_ground_truth.patch_resolves_note: The staged fix adds `if ( face->palette_data.num_palettes * 2 + 3U * 4 > table_size ) goto InvalidTable;` immediately before the buggy skip/read sequence, so this malformed CPAL v1 header is rejected before `FT_NEXT_ULONG( p )` executes.

poc.trigger: Use the exact staged 4574-byte witness. On the crashing path, the sfnt directory at offset 67 resolves `CPAL` to file offset 4260 with length 288, and the first 12 bytes there are `00 01 20 20 20 20 00 20 00 00 00 20`; those fields decode to `version=1`, `num_palette_entries=8224`, `num_palettes=8224`, `num_colors=32`, and `colors_offset=32`, which is the concrete state that makes `table` alias that 288-byte region and then drives the skip 16172 bytes past its logical extent before the crash at `tt_face_load_cpal`.

format.name: TTC-like font with malformed CPAL version-1 header
format.contract: Use the exact staged 4574-byte witness. It must preserve the sfnt directory at offset 67 with a `CPAL` record at file offset 4260 and length 288, plus the CPAL header bytes `00 01 20 20 20 20 00 20 00 00 00 20`. Those exact fields force FreeType to accept the color-record bounds (`colors_offset=32`, `num_colors=32`) yet compute `num_palettes * 2 + 3 * 4 = 16460 > 288`, so `p += num_palettes * 2` advances from `table + 12` to `table + 16460`, 16172 bytes past the `CPAL` extent inside the in-memory stream, before the first version-1 offset read.
